parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence or documented border/facility/custody restriction reaches visitors; 2023 decriminalisation removes a tangential sexuality statute. Missing LGR and GI anti-discrimination are resident gaps, not direct exposures, though they weaken recourse and signal partial institutional climate. Evidence includes resort welcoming, police protecting Pride, PM support, religious condemnation of threats, and youth acceptance polls (non-trans-specific). Negatives are social/political hostility: 2018 death-threat Pride cancellation, 2024 election hate speech, pervasive stigma, and possible hospital discrimination. Single 2016 harassment is weak; no trans-violence rate or targeting campaign. Unknown custody/documents are open questions, not proven exposures. Consequences if outed likely harassment/unequal service, not imprisonment or state violence; rate low reduced.
